prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the passenger in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Sugar Land, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1462; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it as the passenger, if that's okay. I was in the car that got sideswiped.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: We were on the main road in Sugar Land, heading toward the shopping center. It was a clear afternoon and traffic was moving fairly well.

Q: Who was driving, and what was the vehicle doing at the time?
A: My friend was driving. We were in the right lane, and the other car came over from the left lane and clipped the side of us as it changed lanes. It didn't look like they checked their mirror.

Q: Did you see the other driver signal before they moved over?
A: I didn't see a signal. I was looking at my phone, so I honestly can't say for sure.

Q: What happened to your body during the impact?
A: I was jolted sideways and then forward against the seatbelt. My lower back hit the seat hard, and I felt a sharp pain right away.

Q: Did you seek medical attention afterward?
A: Yes, we went to urgent care that evening. They said it looked like a back strain and gave me some muscle relaxers and told me to rest.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?
A: Yes, it's been a few weeks now. Sitting for long periods is the hardest part, and I've had to skip some shifts at work because of it.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm hoping this gets sorted out, because I didn't do anything to cause it.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
A: Thank you.
